apps.localizedDescription: Decide which platform every train gets and who goes first, with the real timetables of Wien, Salzburg and Budapest. Beta version, actively developed by NWorks. © 2026 NWorks. All rights reserved.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Budapest-Déli and Budapest-Keleti now run the real weekday timetable of MÁV, with real train numbers, lines and destinations: S10, S12, S40, S60, S80, Z30, Z60, G-trains, InterRégió, IC, EC and Railjet.
• All four stations can be played from the start. Stars no longer unlock anything.
• New "Credits" tab in the menu: where every timetable comes from, and under which licence.
• First version for iPhone, installed through AltStore.
